description: T-2612: does a sheet with the old name revive plain references to a deleted sheet? Sheet S holds C4:C7 = 1,2,4,8; sheet F holds A1 =SUM(S!C4:C7), A2 FORMULATEXT(A1), A3 =S!C4, A4 FORMULATEXT(A3), A5 =COUNTBLANK(S!C4:C7), A6 FORMULATEXT(A5), A7 =INDIRECT("S!C4")&"|", A8 FORMULATEXT(A7), A9 =ISREF(S!A1), A10 FORMULATEXT(A9). Ops: delete_sheet S, then add a new blank sheet S. A revived reference reads the new blank S (A1 0, A3 0, A5 4); a lost one is #REF!.
